_comment: OpenAI / OpenAI-compatible API templates. Compatible with: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, MiniMax, GLM, Ollama (with compat layer), vLLM, etc.

openai_env.name: openai_env
openai_env.description: Inject OPENAI_API_KEY for OpenAI SDK and CLI tools
openai_env.cli: harness vault template add openai/api --name openai_env --env '{"OPENAI_API_KEY": "$value"}'

openai_org_env.name: openai_org_env
openai_org_env._note: Set OPENAI_ORG_ID to your organization ID. For OpenRouter, MiniMax, GLM, also set the appropriate base URL env var (OPENAI_BASE_URL).

curl_bearer.name: curl_bearer
curl_bearer.description: Wrap curl with Bearer token for OpenAI-compatible APIs
